meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 dial 命令行通过一个真实手机号发短信、用 AI 语音打电话,并等待、读取收到的短信和验证码。它先查各命令的 --help,输出优先用 --json 方便解析。
howto.when: 当用户提到短信、电话、验证码(OTP/2FA)等手机相关话题,或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发;会话中首次运行 dial 命令前也应先加载本技能。

say.text: 帮我给 +14155550123 发条短信,内容说会议改到三点
say.note: 用本环境已接好的号码发送

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打个语音电话,让对方确认明天的预约
say.note: 由 AI 语音代理通话,可指定男/女声

say.text: 等 +14155550123 发来的短信,把验证码读出来
say.note: 长轮询监听收到的短信事件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the `dial` CLI to send SMS, place AI-handled voice calls, and wait for inbound texts and verification codes on a real phone number. It checks each command's --help first and prefers --json output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention texts, calls, SMS, OTP/2FA or verification codes, ask to text or call someone or wait for a code, or before the first `dial` command in a session.

say_en.text: Text +14155550123 saying the meeting moved to 3pm.
say_en.note: Sent from the line wired into this environment.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and have the agent confirm tomorrow's appointment.
say_en.note: An AI voice agent handles the call.

say_en.text: Wait for the SMS from +14155550123 and read me the code.
